mihomo.config:
mixed-port: 63920
mode: rule
log-level: warning
external-controller: 127.0.0.1:63922
secret: t5-secret
profile:
  store-selected: false
  store-fake-ip: false
geodata-mode: true
hosts:
  host-only.test: '127.0.0.1'
  alias.test: 'alias-target.test'
dns:
  enable: true
  listen: 127.0.0.1:63921
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16
  fake-ip-filter: ['+.real.test', 'alias-target.test', 'absent.test']
  use-hosts: true
  ipv6: false
  nameserver: ['udp://127.0.0.1:58757']
rule-providers:
  rp-yaml:
    type: file
    behavior: domain
    format: yaml
    path: providers/rp.yaml
  rp-text:
    type: file
    behavior: domain
    format: text
    path: providers/rp.txt
  rp-mrs:
    type: file
    behavior: domain
    format: mrs
    path: providers/rp.mrs
  rp-http:
    type: http
    behavior: domain
    format: yaml
    url: http://127.0.0.1:63908/rules.yaml
proxy-providers:
  pp-sub:
    type: file
    path: providers/nodes.yaml
    health-check:
      enable: true
      url: 'http://127.0.0.1:63907/generate_204'
      interval: 60
proxies:
  - {name: ss-node, type: ss, server: 127.0.0.1, port: 63909, cipher: aes-256-gcm, password: t5-ss-pass, udp: true}
  - {name: trojan-node, type: trojan, server: 127.0.0.1, port: 63913, password: t5-trojan-pass, sni: 'localhost', skip-cert-verify: true}
  - {name: ssr-node, type: ssr, server: 127.0.0.1, port: 63917, cipher: aes-256-cfb, password: t5-ssr-pass, protocol: origin, obfs: plain}
  - {name: bad-ss, type: ss, server: 127.0.0.1, port: 63909, cipher: aes-256-gcm, password: wrong-pass}
proxy-groups:
  - {name: PROXY, type: select, proxies: [ss-node, trojan-node, ssr-node]}
  - {name: AUTO, type: url-test, proxies: [ss-node, trojan-node], url: 'http://127.0.0.1:63907/generate_204', interval: 60, tolerance: 50, lazy: false}
  - {name: FALLBACK, type: fallback, proxies: [ss-node, trojan-node], url: 'http://127.0.0.1:63907/generate_204', interval: 60, lazy: false}
  - {name: BAD, type: select, proxies: [bad-ss]}
  - {name: SUB, type: select, use: [pp-sub]}
rules:
  - RULE-SET,rp-http,REJECT
  - RULE-SET,rp-yaml,PROXY
  - GEOSITE,t5site,REJECT
  - RULE-SET,rp-text,REJECT
  - RULE-SET,rp-mrs,REJECT
  - DOMAIN,bad.localhost,BAD
  - DST-PORT,63905,trojan-node
  - GEOIP,zz,ss-node
  - MATCH,ssr-node
